# iPhone Link v4.0.0 (Native Rust Spatial Edition) - Windows 10 & 11

> **iPhone Link v4.0.0** (created by **Kelvin Daniyar**, `@kelvindaniyar`) is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0), Native Rust desktop application for Windows 10 and Windows 11 (64-bit) providing macOS Sequoia-class iPhone & iPad mirroring over USB Cable and Wi-Fi Low-Latency.

## Canonical Links

- Official Interactive Website: https://kelvindaniyar.github.io/iphone-link/
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/kelvindaniyar/iphone-link
- Official 64-Bit Installer (`Setup.exe`): https://github.com/kelvindaniyar/iphone-link/releases/latest/download/iPhone-Link-v4.0.0-Setup.exe
- Portable Native Rust Package (`.zip`): https://github.com/kelvindaniyar/iphone-link/releases/latest/download/iPhone-Link-Win64-Native-Rust-v4.0.0.zip
- Creator Support (Saweria): https://saweria.co/kelvindaniyar
- Upstream Attribution: Forked from https://github.com/teyboxv1/pane-iphone-mirror-windows (GPL-3.0), USB communication via https://github.com/doronz88/pymobiledevice3.

## Key Capabilities & Upgrades in v4.0.0

- **100% Native Rust Architecture**: `~1.33 MB` executable (down 93% from `19.26 MB` in v2.0), `< 0.25s` cold boot, `0.00%` idle CPU, zero `Python.Runtime.dll` dependency, and automatic `:Zone.Identifier` unblocking.
- **USB Cable & Wi-Fi Low-Latency Mirroring**: 60fps hardware H.265 mirroring over USB or local Wi-Fi mDNS (`_remotepairing._tcp.local`), physically tested on **iPhone 17 Pro (iOS 27.2)**, **iPhone 11 Pro Max (iOS 27.2)**, and **iPad (4:3)**.
- **Official 64-Bit Installer (`Setup.exe`, 60.52 MB)**: Packs an isolated Python 3.12 runtime, LAN firewall rules, shortcuts, and offline `Microsoft.HEVCVideoExtension_2.5.48.0` bundle so users do not need manual Python setup.
- **True DWM Acrylic Blur Lock & Spatial UI**: Maintains translucent frosted blur when unfocused (`WM_NCACTIVATE`) in Dark Aurora and Light Frost modes with concentric `12px`/`9px` pill geometry and full ID/EN UI translation.
- **Productivity & Control**: 32-scenario Smart Auto-Rotate (`270°` landscape gaming & YouTube Fullscreen), Multi-Frame OCR Stitcher (`Alt+C`), HID Text Paste (`Alt+V`), `0x0070` Stealth Dim (`Alt+D`), permanent Auto-Unlock PIN (`Alt+U`), Wireless Audio + Lip-Sync presets, 18-control dual-storage persistence, Built-in OTA Software Updater, and 9-item System Tray with `Start with Windows`.
- **Privacy**: 100% local execution on `127.0.0.1`. Zero cloud servers, zero telemetry, zero login required.
